I am 60 years old and I have farmed this land in Oromia since I was a young girl. This plot is only 0.12 hectares, a small piece near my house, so I will plant my own local maize seed that I kept from last year and put manure from my animals on it. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this tiny plot because one bag costs too much and is far too much for this land — I need to save my cash for the bigger fields. My children and I can do all the work ourselves, planting, weeding by hand, and harvesting, so I do not need to pay anyone to help.
